insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Noggin Boss delivered $229 in total sales for Week 45 on 3 units, with every sale coming from organic demand. The Plain Grey Crazy Party Hat led at $79 with a strong 14.3% conversion rate, followed by the Plain Purple hat at $74 (12.5% CVR) and the Plain Navy hat at $74. Tuesday, Nov 3 was the peak day at $79.

**Metrics to Watch —** Total sales were $229 versus $449 the prior week (-48.9% WoW), with all sales landing Sunday through Tuesday and $0 from Wednesday to Saturday. The Plain Navy hat drew 22 sessions (-12.0%) at a 4.5% CVR, and the Brown, Camo and Pink Oversized Hats picked up 13, 8 and 6 sessions without converting yet, so we are focused on turning that traffic into orders.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** We restarted advertising this week with $15 in ad spend, generating a solid 1.83% ad CTR but no attributed PPC revenue yet, putting TACoS at 6.9%. Spend remains small while campaigns gather data, and we will keep budgets tight until ad clicks begin converting.

**Actions This Week —** We will shift ad budget toward the Plain Grey and Plain Purple hats, which converted at 14.3% and 12.5%, and refine targeting and bids to lift ad CVR above 0.00%. We will also test new Sponsored Product and Sponsored Brand ad creative for the Oversized Hat line to build on the 1.83% ad CTR and convert its growing sessions.
